detection_method: Network IDS/IPS detecting ARP spoofing attempts with frequent gratuitous ARP packets, monitoring for HTTP Basic Auth headers in traffic over unsecured Wi-Fi networks, endpoint detection for unauthorized MITM proxy processes, and alerting on plaintext credential exposure.
